name: Aranmula Kannadi
description: The Aranmula Kannadi is a unique handmade metal mirror produced in Aranmula, a village in Kerala. Unlike standard glass mirrors, it is made from a special metal alloy of copper and tin. It is front-surface reflective, giving it a distortion-free image, and is considered a bringer of good luck and prosperity, often included in the Vishukkani.
notes: Representative of the unique metal-alloy mirror tradition of Kerala
